files.description: Working rules for AI agents: architecture, testing rules, code style, the comment policy and the tool schema rule this repo enforces. Read it before judging a comment, a test or a tool change: it is the source of truth these reviews are graded against.
Submission quality bar and code standards, identical for human and AI authors.
The Mural public API endpoints and scopes this server calls. Check claims about Mural behaviour against it.
Why the mutation gate exists and what a surviving mutant means: an assertion is missing or too loose, never a reason to weaken one.
